excerpt: Traba supplies vetted shift workers to US warehouses, distribution centres and factories, and now sells AI tools for industrial operations. Founded in 2021.
content:
Traba is a US labour marketplace for the industrial supply chain. Businesses such as warehouses, distribution centres, food producers, third-party logistics firms and manufacturers post shifts; background-checked workers pick them up through Traba's app. Its website says it has around 400,000 US work-eligible, background-checked workers, a 98% show rate, one to two days' average time to fill, and 24/7 support with cover for no-shows. Traba now describes itself as an AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain: in June 2026 it launched Neo, software that it says helps operations teams with labour forecasting and shift planning.

TechCrunch reported in 2022 that Mike Shebat and Akshay Buddiga founded Traba in 2021. Shebat, the CEO, had worked as a warehouse manager at McMaster-Carr and in Uber's early Uber Eats team; Buddiga had worked at Zenefits and Fanatics. At that point Traba had about 12,000 workers on the platform and required a minimum of $13 an hour.

Funding

Traba raised a $20 million Series A in July 2022 led by Khosla Ventures, with Founders Fund and General Catalyst among the participants, at a $120 million post-money valuation, according to TechCrunch. In October 2023 Refresh Miami reported a further $22 million round led by Founders Fund, with Khosla participating, and described Traba as Miami-based.

Pricing

Traba does not publish rates on its website. TechCrunch reported that companies pay only for shifts actually filled through the platform, invoiced from approved timesheets; worker pay rates vary by job.

Who it suits

Traba fits operations managers in light-industrial businesses whose staffing needs rise and fall, such as peak seasons in e-commerce fulfilment. It is less relevant to office roles or businesses outside the US.

We have not used Traba. This page draws on Traba's website, TechCrunch, Refresh Miami and Traba's June 2026 press release.
